title: SubagentExitPayload
description: The JSON a Worker/Verifier/Test-Fixer emits as its final output. The orchestrator parses this and derives the canonical loop-detection hash from it.

status.description: COMPLETED only if the mission objective was met. Unparseable output is treated as FAILED.

files_modified.description: Paths modified, relative to the allowed scope. Sorted into the hash, so order does not matter.

debrief.description: Concise changes, trade-offs, verification performed. Must be deterministic: no timestamps, no run ids — non-deterministic text defeats duplicate detection.

self_audit.description: Answer to: 'Is that the best I could do following best practices?'
